amendments.reason: A GetObject request carries no s3:prefix key, so s3:ListBucket under StringLike s3:prefix never applies to GetObject and missing keys would still return 403. StringLikeIfExists keeps ListObjects limited to <env>/ while letting GetObject return 404. User chose this at the contract check.

changes.before: s3:ListBucket on the bucket ARN with an s3:prefix condition for <env>/ (StringLike)
changes.after: s3:ListBucket on the bucket ARN with StringLikeIfExists s3:prefix <env>/* (publisher always, reader under the pull parameter); decision notes it is unproven until the manual real-AWS recipe runs
